entities.name: Sodium ethanethiolate
observations: ORD precedents identify sodium ethanethiolate (NaSEt) in DMF as a close reagent system for selective aryl O-demethylation of the decoded substrate.
This reagent assignment is database-supported by close ORD records, not independently inferred from the SELFIES token sequence.

entities.name: Ethanethiol
observations: Ethanethiol with sodium hydride in DMF is a close alternative, likely generating sodium ethanethiolate in situ for aryl O-demethylation.
Additional records use ethanethiol with sodium or n-butyllithium, with DMF and aqueous or acidic workup components.

entities.name: Sodium hydride
observations: NaH is reported with ethanethiol and DMF in a close precedent; its likely role is generation of ethanethiolate in situ.

entities.name: Selective aryl O-demethylation
observations: The transformation converts one aryl methoxy group to phenol and does not incorporate phosphorus or sulfur.
Close ORD records include ord-5ace6a73b7804658835000d3ba8d675e, ord-882ec60b3c4641a8b43bf6fab6d2e420, ord-bfbfb963eef947238a2e3a408c9af258, and ord-71c20207ede24712bed6078780352a80.
